comment: Code in this directory that was not written here, and what it is.
Both files below run on the pages where people sign transactions. They are
vendored rather than loaded from a CDN because the content policy those
pages are served with allows scripts from this origin and nowhere else,
and that policy is most of what stands between an injected script and a
A vendored file nobody can identify is its own problem: there is no way to
tell an upgrade from a substitution. So each is recorded here with the
package and version it came from, where to fetch it again, and its
SHA-256. pages.test.js fails if a file here differs from its hash, or if a
minified script appears in this directory that is not listed.
